title: Reading Drill — A Collection of Oral Histories
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Collection of Oral Histories
passages.body:
**A** An archive recorded residents describing a demolished factory. Interviewers invited speakers to bring a photograph, which often prompted them to describe a particular shift or machine in detail.

**B** The archive found that some accounts disagreed about dates. Its editor kept the differences and attached relevant pay records so a reader could compare interview claims with surviving documents.

**C** Names were included only with permission. People reluctant to be identified could review a short transcript and ask the team to remove any identifying details before publication.
